title: Firebot Community Plugin Manifest
description: A manifest file that describes a community plugin that will be listed in Firebot for end users to search for, install, and update.

name.description: Display name of your plugin (e.g. `My Cool Plugin`)

author.description: Your name, as the author of this plugin (e.g. `Firebot`)

description.description: A brief description of your plugin. Markdown is supported.

version.description: Version of your plugin this manifest represents. Must be a semver string with exactly 3 period-separated components: Major, minor, and patch. (e.g. `1.0.0`)

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL for the plugin file

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the plugin file specified in `downloadUrl`. Firebot will validate this hash after downloading your plugin.

releaseDate.description: Release date of this version of your plugin. Must be an ISO-8601 formatted string.

type.description: Type of file your plugin is. Only `single-file` is supported at this time.

icon.description: Optional. An icon representing your plugin. This can either be a Font Awesome icon or a custom URL.

name.description: A FontAwesome icon name shown in the UI (eg. `fa-cogs`).

color.description: A CSS color value (e.g. `#FF0000`) used for the icon.

url.description: A URL for the icon image. This can be a data URL.

backgroundColor.description: A CSS color value (e.g. `#FF0000`) used for the background of the icon.

category.description: Optional. The category your plugin best fits under.

features.description: Optional. An array of Firebot features that your plugin implements. Each implemented feature only needs to be included in the array once.

tags.description: Optional. An array of strings that describe or categorize your plugin.

repo.description: Optional. A link to the plugin's source code repository.

website.description: Optional. A link to the plugin's website. If the repo is on GitHub and the website is not specified, it will default to the GitHub repo URL.

support.description: Optional. A link to the plugin's issue tracker or support server (e.g. Discord). If the repo is on GitHub and support is not specified, it will default to the GitHub issues URL.

minimumFirebotVersion.description: Optional. The lowest Firebot version this version of your plugin is compatible with.

maximumFirebotVersion.description: Optional. The highest Firebot version this version of your plugin is compatible with.
